english.title: Park a motor vehicle / bicycle / conveyance on the Croydon Tramlink system other than in accordance with instructions
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) being the person in charge of a

(A)_[motor vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..)]_
(B)_[bicycle]_
(C)_[conveyance, namely **(..SPECIFY THE CONVEYANCE..)]_

left or placed it on a part of

(D)_[a tramstop, namely **(..SPECIFY THE TRAMSTOP..),]_
(E)_[the authorised railways, namely **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..),]_

on the Croydon Tramlink system otherwise than in accordance with

(F)_[the instructions of the Operator or other person on its behalf,]_
(G)_[directions from an authorised person,]_

namely **(..SPECIFY THE INSTRUCTION OR DIRECTION DISOBEYED..)
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 15(1)(b) and 26 of the Croydon Tramlink Byelaws made under section 46 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994.
english.pointstoprove:
date and place
being the person ion charge of a motor vehicle / bicycle / other conveyance
left / placed it on a part of a tramstop / the authorised railways
on the Croydon Tramlink system
otherwise than in accordance with the instructions of the Operator / other person or
directions from an authorised person.

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) "Authorised railways" has the same meaning as in section 2 of the Croydon Tramlink Act 1994 (Byelaw 1(a)).
(ii) This Byelaw applies only to any part of any tramstop or the authorised railways which is not situated in a street over which the public have a right of passage.
